result.title: Boiling Down Uncertainty: Deep Generative Scenario Search with Decision-Guided Evolution Strategies for Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization
result.summary: One of the most common models for handling uncertainty is two-stage stochastic programming. Choosing the right number of scenarios is a trade-off between the uncertainty that can be represented and computational cost. A recent method, Deep Generative Scenario Search, generates synthetic scenarios and improves them by learning from the decisions they induce. The original approach used a black-box gradient estimate, since decisions are piecewise constant across scenarios. This paper provides the missing analytical foundation by deriving the gradient in closed form from recourse duality and an adjoint solve of the regularized reduced problem. The decision-focused direction, with a heuristic direction as a backup when duals are unavailable, defines the sampling subspace of a guided evolution strategy rather than being used as a direct update. For any guiding subspace, the expected update is a descent direction of the smoothed objective, so an inaccurate guide adds variance while the expected step still descends. For six problem families, both guided estimators outperform the baseline. The decision-focused version reduces the mean gap by three-quarters, and on the two families with the most integer variables the reduced sets beat the exact solver's two-hour incumbent in most runs, using a fifth of the time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为深度生成式场景搜索补上解析基础：从 recourse 对偶与正则化简化问题的伴随求解导出闭式梯度，把决策导向方向（对偶不可用时用启发式方向兜底）用作引导进化策略的采样子空间而非直接更新，并在六个问题族上优于基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“由下游决策反推生成侧、并借对偶/伴随求解获得贡献方向”的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、以及采样空间的方差—可靠性权衡提供可核查线索。
